name: Fami Fami!
source:
Main character is an ordinary school student in Tokyo. He returns to his home town in Hokkaido for summer vacations and finds his home being reconstructed into a family restaurant. Moreover, there are two cute twin sisters helping out.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-october-2005-ayakashi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是东京一名普通学生。暑假期间，他回到北海道的故乡，却发现自家正在被改建成家庭餐厅，而且还有一对可爱的双胞胎姐妹前来帮忙。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-october-2005-ayakashi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
